Lead, manage, and grow reporting and performance tracking in partnership with other departments and external partners.

Strong time-management and prioritization skills
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

description.overview: Join us as Investment Analyst and help shape the future of our Securities & Brokerage function as we expand across the Finance / Banking / Securities sector.
topReasonsToJoin: Competitive salary reviewed twice a year
Language allowance for English, Japanese, or Korean certificates
Strong work-life balance culture, no unnecessary overtime
responsibilities: Handle core securities & brokerage activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Maintain collaboration with cross-functional departments, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Execute continuous improvement initiatives and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Carry out reporting and performance tracking to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Handle stakeholder communication and updates, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Process day-to-day operations related to the role in partnership with other departments and external partners.

Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Opportunity to work with international partners
Laptop and equipment provided
